VI.description: Sets the opacity or colour key of the layered window hwnd (extended style WS_EX_LAYERED) through user32.dll SetLayeredWindowAttributes (stdcall\2C called in any thread). dwFlags 2 LWA_ALPHA with bAlpha 0 makes the window fully transparent on screen - it stays open\2C functional and capturable with PrintWindow. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure (e.g. the window is not layered). When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: Transparency colour key (COLORREF 0x00BBGGRR)\2C used with dwFlags 1 LWA_COLORKEY.
Opacity with dwFlags 2 LWA_ALPHA\3A 0 transparent\2C 255 opaque.
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.
